title_text: And the Walls Came Tumbling Down
credits_text: Barry Benton, Gareth Hunt, Mary Ann Odum, Nickolas Perry. Starring: Barry Benton, Gareth Hunt, Mary Ann Odum, Nickolas Perry. The Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense. The World Premiere of Two New 1984 Full Length Features.
other_text: They were totally cut off from the outside world, and inside things were getting desperate. The church is about to be demolished ... but it fights back to preserve its own life.
